##### Project general facts

Zuha Island is a world-class boutique retreat offering a collection of just thirty limited-edition exclusive private residences. Set on an island spanning generous grounds with pristine beachfront encircling rich greenery, this extraordinary development provides residents with generous plots, breathtaking city skyline views, and the utmost level of privacy. Each palatial villa reflects the rhythm of the waves and embraces the natural beauty of the island, creating a symphony as unique as its owner.

Residents and guests enjoy access to a world-renowned boutique retreat, spa, and restaurants located on the island. The development offers a seamless blend of luxury and tranquility, with pristine beaches and the bejeweled sea at every doorstep. The island’s exclusive setting ensures an unparalleled level of privacy and serenity, making every moment feel like an escape to a secluded paradise.

Every villa at Zuha Island features state-of-the-art furniture and materials that celebrate and accentuate the curves, light, and shape of the island. A seamless flow between interior and exterior is achieved through neutral palettes and natural materials such as travertine and marble, which permeate each of the six en-suite rooms, including a master suite overlooking the ocean. Four living spaces, multiple terraces, and a choice of dining spaces add subtle elegance to the design. The exquisite bathrooms feature indirect lighting, ocean views, and perfect privacy, reflecting the island’s philosophy of water, healing, peace, and sanctuary. Kitchens are fully equipped.

##### Location description and benefits

Nestled within The World Islands, a remarkable man-made archipelago located off the coast of Dubai, this exceptional location offers an elite retreat of opulence and grandeur. Just a short boat journey from Jumeirah Beach, the islands are designed to provide luxurious and exclusive living experiences, with each representing a different country or region on a world map.

The location is distinguished by its unparalleled privacy and exclusivity. The islands offer a variety of residential options, from lavish villas to private estates, all with panoramic views of the Arabian Gulf and access to pristine beaches. High-end resorts, boutique hotels, entertainment facilities, world-class dining, spa treatments, and water sports are all within reach, creating a secluded paradise where privacy, tranquility, and luxury converge.

For those seeking a residence that embodies island elegance, skyline views, and unmatched exclusivity, The World Islands deliver an unparalleled lifestyle. Their unique combination of man-made grandeur, natural beauty, and a prestigious Dubai address makes them one of the most desirable locations in the world. This is a place where one can escape to a private sanctuary — serene, sophisticated and effortlessly connected to the city that has it all.
